title: Project Architect
description:
**Job Title: PROJECT ARCHITECT**

**ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES**  
The project architect role revolves around managing and overseeing the design and construction of specific projects from inception to completion.  
Key Responsibilities:

 Overall development and implementation of a specific architectural project development, details, and documentation.  
 In charge of coordinating a team effort to complete a project promptly and successfully/  
 Prepare Design Documentation that meet client specifications and propose a budget and time estimates  
 Acts as an intermediary between the client and the architecture team  
 Ensure that the team is working effectively and keeping with the schedule and budget  
 Review all work reports, write reports, and keep client and consultants informed about the status of the project  
 Provide technical coordination of architectural design works with specification writers to document project specifications.  
 Maintain the necessary specifications for standard and non-standard construction  
 Ensure that approvals of drawings and sample materials obtained as specified / approved within the time scale of the program in coordination with the project directors  
 Reviews documents for quality control evaluations  
 Lead a group of designers / draftsman and motivate them to achieve the objectives of the company  
 Attend design, team, and coordination meetings as well as prepare notes for records and pass information to the team  
 Supervises project team and coordinates and maintains project schedule  
 Meets and coordinates with clients and consultants, suppliers, and vendors  
 Actively support vision to grow the use of BIM across all disciplines and deliver projects on BIM.  
 Remains current with industry trends in BIM, digital design, and design technology.  
 Actively researches and implements latest design and construction technologies

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS  
The minimum qualifications for this role are:  
 A bachelors degree in architecture.  
 At least 7 years of experience in a similar role  
 Proficiency in design software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, or other similar tools is essential. Familiarity with graphic design software like Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator is aplus.  
 Ability to create innovative, functional, and aesthetically pleasing designs that meet client needs.  
 Excellent understanding with architectural drafting and documentation standards.  
 Strong knowledge of building codes, regulations, and construction processes.Job Location : Kochi KakkanadSalary: Best in the industryIndustry: Engineering Consultant

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resume to ashley@affable.in or contact 9539310003

title: Academic Counsellor & Documentation Executive
company: YESTE Migration and Education Consulting Pvt. Ltd.
description:
Student Counsellor cum Documentation Specialist – Overseas Education

**Company:** YESTE Migration \& Education Consulting Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Overseas Education / Study Abroad  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full\-time \| On\-site  
**Experience:** 2–5 years in Overseas Education / Study Abroad / Student Counselling / Admissions

About the Role

YESTE Migration \& Education Consulting Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and passionate **Student Counsellor cum Documentation Specialist** to join our Overseas Education Division.

The ideal candidate should be able to independently handle the **complete student journey – from counselling and course/university selection to application preparation, documentation, admission follow\-up and handover to the visa processing team.**

We are looking for someone who combines **strong counselling ability, excellent communication, documentation accuracy, follow\-up discipline and a result\-oriented approach.**

Key Responsibilities

**Student Counselling**

* Counsel students and parents regarding overseas education opportunities, courses, universities and career pathways.
* Understand the student's academic profile, career goals, budget and preferred destination.
* Recommend suitable countries, universities and courses based on student eligibility and career objectives.
* Explain admission requirements, intakes, tuition fees, scholarships and application timelines.
* Handle walk\-in, telephone and online enquiries professionally.
* Build trust and maintain strong relationships with students and parents.

**Application \& Documentation**

* Manage end\-to\-end university/college application processing.
* Review and verify academic certificates, transcripts, passport, CV, SOP, LOR, financial and other supporting documents.
* Identify missing, inconsistent or incorrect information and coordinate with students for corrections.
* Prepare application checklists and ensure documents are complete before submission.
* Complete and submit university applications accurately within deadlines.
* Track application status, conditional/unconditional offers and pending requirements.
* Maintain proper records of every student application.

**Follow\-up \& Admission Conversion**

* Conduct timely and consistent follow\-ups with prospective and existing students.
* Follow up for pending documents, application requirements, offer acceptance, fee payments and other admission formalities.
* Convert qualified enquiries into registrations/applications/admissions through effective counselling and follow\-up.
* Ensure students are regularly updated regarding their application progress and deadlines.

**University \& Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate with universities, institutions, admission teams and internal departments.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of partner universities, courses, intakes and admission requirements.
* Coordinate smooth handover of admitted students to the Visa Documentation Team.
* Escalate complex cases or documentation issues to the appropriate senior team member.

**CRM \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate student records and follow\-up activities in **Zoho CRM/company systems**.
* Update counselling details, application status, follow\-ups and student interactions on time.
* Ensure no assigned lead or student application is left unattended.
* Prepare daily/weekly reports as required by the management.

Destinations

Knowledge of one or more major study\-abroad destinations such as **Australia, UK, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, USA, Germany and other European destinations** will be an advantage.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who has:

* 2–5 years of relevant experience in **Study Abroad / Overseas Education / Student Counselling / University Admissions**.
* Strong student counselling and convincing skills.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong documentation and application\-processing skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Good knowledge of overseas university admission procedures.
* Ability to understand student profiles and recommend suitable study pathways.
* Ability to handle multiple student applications simultaneously.
* Good computer skills and familiarity with CRM systems; **Zoho CRM experience is an advantage.**
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-management skills.
* Target\-oriented and accountable approach.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

Qualifications

**Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification** in any discipline.

Relevant experience in overseas education, international admissions or student counselling will be given preference.

Key Performance Areas

* Quality and effectiveness of student counselling
* Lead follow\-up and enquiry conversion
* Student registrations and applications
* Application accuracy and timely submission
* Admission/offer conversion
* Documentation quality
* CRM discipline and reporting
* Student satisfaction and relationship management
* Achievement of assigned targets

Why Join YESTE?

* Opportunity to work with an established **Migration \& Overseas Education consulting organization**
* Exposure to international education and multiple study destinations
* Professional learning and training opportunities
* Career growth within the Overseas Education Division
* Performance\-driven work environment
* Opportunity to build expertise across counselling, admissions and documentation

**If you are confident in counselling students, strong in documentation, and passionate about helping students achieve their international education goals, we would like to hear from you.**

**Apply now and become part of the YESTE Overseas Education team.**

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Experience:

* Academic counselling: 2 years (Required)
* Overseas Education: 2 years (Required)

Our services include SEO, Social Media Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content Marketing, Web Development, Branding, Graphic Design, and Video Production.

* Create engaging and original content for different client accounts.

* Develop creative hooks, taglines, ideas, and campaign copy.
* Assist in creating SEO\-friendly blogs, articles, website content, and landing page copy.
* Conduct basic research on topics, industries, competitors, and target audiences.
* Adapt writing style and tone according to different brands and audiences.
* Proofread and edit content for grammar, clarity, and consistency.

* Stay updated with social media trends, content formats, and digital marketing trends.
* Learn to use AI content tools for research and ideation while maintaining originality and brand voice.

* **Freshers only.**

* Good written communication skills with strong grammar and vocabulary.
* Ability to write clearly and creatively.
* Good research and storytelling skills.
* Basic understanding of social media platforms.
* Basic knowledge of SEO is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Willingness to learn new content formats, tools, and digital marketing concepts.
* Ability to adapt writing style according to different brands and audiences.
* Good attention to detail.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Basic knowledge of AI content tools is an advantage.
* A degree or relevant educational background in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Marketing, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

What You Will Learn

As a Content Writer Intern at Lime Tea, you will get hands\-on exposure to:

* Social media content writing
* Creative copywriting
* Reel scripts and content hooks
* Blog and article writing
* SEO content writing
* Keyword research
* Website and landing page content
* Advertising and campaign copy
* Content research and competitor analysis

* Working with SEO, social media, performance marketing, design, and development teams

Why Join Lime Tea?

* Work on real projects for brands across India and GCC markets.
* Gain practical experience in a professional digital marketing agency.
* Get exposure to multiple industries and different content styles.
* Learn from SEO, social media, performance marketing, design, and development teams.
* Develop both creative and digital marketing skills.
* Work in a collaborative in\-house environment.
* Opportunity for professional growth and skill development.

Job Details

**Position:** Content Writer Intern  
**Experience:** Fresher  
**Location:** Kaloor, Kochi, Kerala  
**Work Mode:** Full\-Time, On\-Site  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

How to Apply

Interested freshers can apply through Indeed with their updated resume. but **previous professional experience is not required**.

title: SEO Content Writer
description:

SpiderWorks Technologies is a leading digital marketing agency specializing in SEO, social media marketing, web development, branding, and performance marketing. We help businesses strengthen their digital presence through innovative strategies and impactful campaigns.

**About the Role**

SpiderWorks Technologies is looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **SEO Content Writer** to produce high\-quality, engaging, and search\-engine\-optimized content for websites, blogs, and digital marketing campaigns.
